tidbit: Did you know… about 13,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic's OSS Scanner uses artificial intelligence to find security flaws in open-source projects, achieving an 85% detection rate. Confirmed by The Times of India: the tool has received early positive feedback.
Sophos has cut threat investigation time by 96% using OpenAI Daybreak. Reported by OpenAI: the advancement speeds up security threat analysis significantly.
Italy is advancing trusted artificial intelligence in healthcare through regulatory and operational reforms. Reported by Decode39: Leite outlines the country's role in this healthcare artificial intelligence progress.
Chinese brands are shifting from cheap, good products to innovation in emotion, experience, data, and intelligence. Reported by 新浪军事: DeepSeek, South Korea, robots, Xiaomi, and Sheffield exemplify this leapfrog development.
Artificial intelligence empowers rather than replaces mathematicians, according to Google DeepMind's Pushmeet Kohli. Reported by India Today: this comes after mathematicians boycott OpenAI over artificial intelligence research.
Free every hour.
